findings.title: Header Injection via CRLF
findings.description: This diff adds tests for headers containing trailing newlines, but the regex changes to enforce strict \Z anchoring are a positive security improvement (preventing header injection via trailing CRLF). However, the code snippet provided only shows the regex change. If this file is part of a library that allows unvalidated user input to construct headers, the previous regex without \Z allowed 'foo\n' to match as valid, potentially enabling CRLF injection. The change to \Z fixes a Critical header injection vulnerability. There are no hardcoded secrets, auth issues, or weak crypto in this diff. The change is a security fix.
findings.suggestion: The change is correct and fixes a critical header injection vulnerability. Ensure that all header construction paths in the library use these validated regexes. No further action needed for this specific diff, as it strengthens security.
